faq_heading: Burke Mountain condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Burke Mountain. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Burke Mountain, Coquitlam: 77 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 11 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 3 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Burke Mountain rose from 56 in June to 77 in September (+37.5%), and 74 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 9.6% of Coquitlam’s 806 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Burke Mountain?
Burke Mountain also had 65 houses listed and 3 sold in September, against 77 condos and townhomes listed. The Burke Mountain houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Burke Mountain home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

149 townhomes sold in Burke Mountain with a median price of $1,100,000 (the middle half sold between $955,000 and $1,298,000), taking a median of 14 days to sell at 99.5% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $645 per square foot, a median year built of 2023 and a median strata fee of $364 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Burke Mountain?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 77 condos and townhomes listed in Burke Mountain. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Burke Mountain a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Burke Mountain had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Burke Mountain from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 74 condos and townhomes sold in Burke Mountain over those 4 months, out of 475 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Burke Mountain sell for?
faq.a: 149 townhomes sold in Burke Mountain between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,100,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Burke Mountain?
faq.a: The median was 14 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 99.5% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
